_comment: RIFT's fleet as a constellation: the robots and subsystems it coordinates, linked by how they actually talk. Edit as the fleet grows.

nodes.label: RIFT
nodes.text: Real-time Intelligent Fleet Technology — the hub every robot registers with.

nodes.label: DREAM
nodes.text: The command centre: a local AI with memory, mood and dreams.

nodes.label: NORA
nodes.text: Omnidirectional rover. Hosts the fleet WiFi AP and the ESP-NOW proximity mesh.

nodes.label: MILA
nodes.text: Miniature tracked bot. Joins NORA, falls back to her own AP.

nodes.label: WHIP
nodes.text: 18-servo hexapod. Walks, and holds station in the fleet.

nodes.label: KIDA-00
nodes.text: KIDA v0 — dashboard and remote in the fleet HUD.

nodes.label: KIDA-01
nodes.text: KIDA v1 — avatar face, voice-overs, its own dashboard.

nodes.label: IDA
nodes.text: Driven by NORA over infrared (Samsung frames, address 0x0DA1).

nodes.label: ARM
nodes.text: Robotic arm with its own controller family.

nodes.label: NINA
nodes.text: Network Inspector & Notification Assistant — the fleet caretaker, watching health.

nodes.label: Radar
nodes.text: Imposter radar: robots flag any non-fleet WiFi they see.

nodes.label: PIN 1234
nodes.text: Controller lock: a phone must unlock with PIN 1234 to drive.

nodes.label: Mission log
nodes.text: RIFT's mission log — where the fleet records what happened.
